description_en:
An exquisite cup made with high quality obsidian. Drink to directly restore 15% of max health. Restore extra 250 health if you're in at least one of these debuff: Burning, Slow, Poisoned, Electrified. 
Cooldown: 70 seconds.
description_zh:
使用优质黑曜石制成的精致茶杯。饮用后直接恢复最大生命值15%点生命值。若饮用时处于燃烧、中毒、带电、减速状态中的任意一种，额外恢复250点生命值。
冷却：70秒
